scaffold_only.definition: Output contains correct file structure and route stubs but fewer than 2 implemented user interactions.
signals: frontend/backend implementation files are extremely short
placeholder or scaffold markers are present
QA evidence is auto-generated or pending human review only

shallow.definition: Primary journey exists but critical steps are hardcoded, mocked, or non-functional.
signals: sample records are returned from handlers without persistence
forms or list views only serialize payloads without executing a journey

domain_aligned.definition: UI labels, API endpoints, and data models use vocabulary specific to the requested product type instead of generic CRUD nouns.
signals: domain nouns are visible in UI or API artifacts
generic nouns like entity/item/record are absent from primary journey artifacts

demo_usable.definition: Primary journey is visually present, executable, domain-aligned, preview-matched, and supported by journey-based QA evidence.
signals: no visible placeholder text in primary journey artifacts
preview target matches the intended product slice

preview_matched.definition: Preview root serves artifacts from the current run's output, not a legacy or shared sandbox.
signals: preview_runtime.project_root does not point to shared fallback sandboxes
preview runtime and run project type are coherent

visually_incomplete.definition: All functional checks pass but the primary journey visual presentation is below mid-fidelity: layout is default browser flow, interactive affordances are not visually discoverable, or implementation lines are below threshold.
signals: frontend implementation has fewer than 8 non-empty lines
no interactive affordances detected (button, form, onClick, fetch, router)
